boon.description: # One of the target's normal wounds is converted into a critical wound after this spell resolves.

conservative.requirements: 2 power, living target within close range. If you are engaged with an enemy add 0 to your dice pool. Effect: You siphon vital essence from the target. For each wound you inflict, you may heal 1 wound or gain 1 power.

success.description: 4+ The target suffers wounds equal to the number of critical wounds he is suffering from.

boon.description: Affect a second target within close range.

sigmarsComet.description: Affect all living enemies within close range.

reckless.requirements: 2 power, living target within close range. If you are engaged with an enemy add 1 to your dice pool. Effect: You siphon vital essence from the target. For each target you affect, you may heal 2 wounds or gain 2 power.
